name: Kroger Grocery Distribution Center Nashville TN

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open paved apron meets the public road (Polk/Foster Ave frontage) with no barrier arm, swing/sliding gate, or checkpoint. Only orange traffic cones channel vehicles across the apron (2025-09 Street View). Uncontrolled access.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure of any kind at the road frontage or anywhere on the apron; confirmed in Street View from multiple headings.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Building sits one short apron-depth (~1-2 trucks) back from the road; vehicles reach the dock face or van staging almost immediately after leaving the road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: South building face shows ~14-18 dock bays in tight z19/z20 imagery, several with Kroger blue delivery vans / box trucks backed in; banded 10-25. Estimated from overhead, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: This is a last-mile fulfillment spoke operating mostly small Kroger delivery vans, not 53' trailers. A few trailers/box trucks sit in the south yard; most trailers along the SE edge belong to the adjacent property along the rail line. Banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot for this tenant; the operation is van-based last-mile, so false.
fieldNotes.railServed: A mainline rail runs along the SE property edge but does NOT spur into the Kroger property; trailers/railcars seen there are adjacent, not served by a Kroger spur.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Nashville's dense industrial fabric near the airport/Foster Ave corridor; clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One physical warehouse structure (multi-tenant; Kroger leases ~40,000 SF of it per public records). Footprint measured ~250m x ~34m.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 15.3 acres derived from the traced perimeter polygon (building + south operational yard inside the property line bounded by the road SW and rail SE).
fieldNotes.facilityContext: Confirmed as Kroger Fulfillment Network LLC, 1116 Polk Ave, Nashville TN 37210 (Ocado-linked grocery e-commerce / last-mile spoke). Per WARN notice the site is slated to permanently close 2026-02-01 (132 employees); audited from 2025-09 imagery while still operating.
